question: Who became India’s first weightlifter to win a gold medal at the IWF Junior World Championships, in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harshada Sharad Garud**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Harshada Sharad Garud became the first Indian weightlifter to win a gold medal at the IWF Junior World Championships in 2022.
 
• She achieved this historic feat in the women's 45 kg category.
 
• Harshada lifted a total of 153 kg (70 kg in snatch and 83 kg in clean and jerk) to clinch the gold.
 
• This event marked a significant milestone for Indian weightlifting on the global stage.
 
• The IWF Junior World Championships 2022 were held in Heraklion, Greece.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Weightlifting Federation (IWF)**

 
 
• The IWF is the international governing body for the sport of Olympic weightlifting.
 
• It was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• The IWF organizes and oversees world championships and other competitions in weightlifting.
 
• It is responsible for the rules and regulations governing the sport globally.
 
 
 
• **Weightlifting Categories**
 
 
• Weightlifting competitions are divided into different weight categories for both men and women.
 
• Each category has specific weight limits that athletes must adhere to.
 
• The main lifts in weightlifting are the snatch and the clean and jerk.
 
• Competitors' total scores are the sum of their best lifts in both disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Training and Preparation**
 
 
• Weightlifters undergo rigorous training regimes to build strength, technique, and endurance.
 
• Proper nutrition and recovery are critical components of a weightlifter's training program.
 
• Mental preparation and focus are also essential for success in competitions.
 
 
 
• **India's Progress in Weightlifting**
 
 
• Indian weightlifters have been making significant strides in international competitions in recent years.
 
• Notable achievements include medals at the Commonwealth Games and the Asian Championships.
 
• The support from the Sports Authority of India (SAI) and other organizations has been pivotal in this progress.
 
• Young talents like Harshada Sharad Garud are helping to elevate the country's standing in the sport.
